name: Battery Rescue SG
regions_note: Onsite areas on its site: Woodlands, Sembawang, Yishun, Yio Chu Kang (North); Ang Mo Kio, Hougang, Sengkang, Punggol (North-East). Its walk-in Motoserv outlets add Serangoon Garden (North-East), Toa Payoh, Upper Thomson, Bukit Timah, Jervois, Havelock Road (Central) and Bukit Batok, Bukit Panjang, Boon Lay (West). The Sembawang outlet is North.
title: Battery Rescue SG | Onsite Car Battery Replacement
desc: Battery Rescue SG fits Delkor car batteries at your car in the north of Singapore, or walk in to 10 Motoserv outlets. Hotline 8125 9169, 24 hours.

card_text: Onsite car battery replacement that comes to where your car is stuck.
Delkor batteries with a one-year warranty, plus jump-start and towing.
lede: Battery Rescue SG replaces car batteries where the car is stuck, so a flat battery does not mean waiting for a tow. Every battery fitted is a Delkor with a one-year warranty. Call the 24-hour hotline on 8125 9169, or send your location and car model on WhatsApp.

services.d: A matching Delkor battery fitted at your car in Woodlands, Sembawang, Yishun, Ang Mo Kio, Yio Chu Kang, Hougang, Sengkang and Punggol.
Ten outlets, Monday to Saturday 9am to 6pm. A $20 website code takes $20 off the list price, for walk-ins only.
A jump-start at your car when the battery is flat but may still be good.
Towing when the car cannot be started on the spot. King dolly lifts all four wheels off the ground.

price_note: Prices include the battery, fitting and GST and were checked on 26 October 2026. If the technician attends and the fault is not the battery, an onsite fee of $50 to $80 applies.
service_area: Onsite service: Woodlands, Sembawang, Yishun, Ang Mo Kio, Yio Chu Kang, Hougang, Sengkang and Punggol.
hours_note: Sundays and late nights: call and the battery is fitted at your car instead.

faqs: Can you come to me if my car will not start?
Yes, in Woodlands, Sembawang, Yishun, Ang Mo Kio, Yio Chu Kang, Hougang, Sengkang and Punggol. Call the 24-hour hotline or WhatsApp your location and car model.
Which battery brand do you fit?
Delkor only, made by Clarios Delkor in Korea. Every battery carries a one-year warranty.
How is the onsite price worked out?
It is the battery price plus a $50 onsite fee before 10pm, or plus $80 from 10pm to 9am and on public holidays. Example for an NS40ZL: $169.90 by day, $199.90 at night.
At any of 10 Motoserv outlets, Monday to Saturday 9am to 6pm. The $20 website code applies to walk-ins only.
